## Names

<a id="draw_runner_step"></a>
### [`draw_runner_step`](../../../../src/room/room_hazard_draw.asm#L9) `$404E`

*routine*

Moves a runner hazard one cell: play_runner_sound (sound $89), draws tile $1C (char E5, the track) at the old column runner_old_col and tile $1B (char E4, the runner) at the new column runner_col, both in row runner_row. The char $64 of the runner tile kills an actor on contact (handle_touched_tile). Used by rooms 7, 9 and 17 and by the room 13 floor movers (update_floor_movers).

- **Called from:** [`update_floor_movers`](../game/game_setup.md#update_floor_movers) [`$1083`](../../../../src/game/game_setup.asm#L196), [`update_floor_movers`](../game/game_setup.md#update_floor_movers) [`$10AC`](../../../../src/game/game_setup.asm#L215), [`room09_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room09_frame) [`$3C2C`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_8_11.asm#L215), [`room17_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room17_frame) [`$3FA6`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_12_17.asm#L219)
- **Jumped to from:** [`room07_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room07_frame) [`$3A4E`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_0_7.asm#L613), [`room07_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room07_frame) [`$3A5F`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_0_7.asm#L624)
- **Calls:** [`play_runner_sound`](room_hazard_draw.md#play_runner_sound), [`print_message`](../actor/actor_driver_text.md#print_message)
- **Jumps to:** [`print_message`](../actor/actor_driver_text.md#print_message)
- **Reads:** [`runner_row`](../../memory-map.md#runner_row), [`runner_old_col`](../../memory-map.md#runner_old_col), [`runner_col`](../../memory-map.md#runner_col)

<a id="draw_slider0"></a>
### [`draw_slider0`](../../../../src/room/room_hazard_draw.asm#L46) `$4086`

*routine*

Draws tile $1F + A (slider frame A, 0-6) at row slider_row, column slider_col (slider 0). Frames: tiles $1F-$25 = D6 / D5 / D5 D6 / D4 D5 / 00 D5 / 00 D4 / 00 00 (frame 6 is blank). Their top chars $54-$5A kill an actor on contact (handle_touched_tile), except in room 18.

- **Called from:** [`room05_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room05_frame) [`$3923`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_0_7.asm#L442), [`room05_frame`](room_frames_0_7.md#room05_frame) [`$3931`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_0_7.asm#L449), [`room08_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room08_frame) [`$3B5F`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_8_11.asm#L94), [`room08_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room08_frame) [`$3B6D`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_8_11.asm#L101), [`room17_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room17_frame) [`$3FF0`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_12_17.asm#L262), [`room17_frame`](room_frames_12_17.md#room17_frame) [`$401C`](../../../../src/room/room_frames_12_17.asm#L288)
